palette.notes: never pure white; lit warm by candle
reserved for seals and future Thread
warm dark velvet, falls to ink at edges

identity: Single candle is the only light; everything outside its radius falls to ink
Cards are woodcut prints on bone paper with a double ink border and Roman numerals
Querent sits across the table as a silhouette lit from below
Score axes are materials: Light = gold leaf, Gravity = ink, total = vermilion wax seal
materials: chalk position labels on velvet cloth
lighting: One candle, upper-left of the spread. Radial warm falloff to near-black. Flicker 3-6 Hz drives light radius and card shadow offsets. Cards cast hard-ish shadows away from the candle.
camera: Orthographic top-down 2D, portrait 720x1280 base (Android phone). Querent top 22%, score + candle 18%, spread 28%, hand bottom 26%.
ui: IM Fell English (OFL) for all text; numbers large old-style. Buttons are paper tags with ink border; Reading names stamped in vermilion. No glossy panels, no gradients except candlelight.
motion: Physical: flakes rise and settle, ink drops fall with gravity, stamps hit with a 6% overshoot and hold 0.25 s, candle gutters sideways when the Shadow acts. Speed x1/x2/x4/instant.
nonnegotiables: Gold for Light, ink for Gravity, wax seal for final Insight
Shadow intents shown as an ink stain/shadow before they happen
deliberate_changes: Card art is procedural woodcut-style emblems, not the 1909 illustrations (no art pipeline yet)
authored_note: Text-only brief: every choice here is authored from 'Quintessence: Visual Effects Direction' in the design conversation, not extracted from an image.
